newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury's Summers upbeat on U.S. economy.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury's Summers upbeat on U.S. economy.

text.p: Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers Thursday delivered an upbeat assessment of the U.S. economy, calling it as strong and as well balanced as it has been for decades.
"Particularly encouraging, over the last year, has been the tendency for wage growth to run ahead of price growth," he told reporters.
Summers called the United States the most competitive nation in the world and gave the strong U.S. private sector much of the credit for that.
But he said that sound economic policies had also played a role, among them, reducing the budget deficit, supporting a strong currency and respecting the independence of the Fed.
